main.description: Upload a legal document to a matter. Body contains vault-encrypted ciphertext (per ADR root §Vault Zero-Knowledge Invariant; server never sees plaintext). Server (1) stores ciphertext as B2 blob keyed by SHA-256 cid, (2) mints documentDid = did:gftd:{firm}:{matter}:{doc} via ai.gftd.auth.mintChildDid (materialKind='doc', docCid=cid), (3) writes legalDocument record. Privileged by default; AI-generated drafts enter status='pendingReview' awaiting approverBengoshiDid.

cid.description: SHA-256 hex of vault-encrypted ciphertext (pre-computed client-side)

aiGenerated.description: When true, record enters status=pendingReview until ISCO-2611 approval (RULE-003)

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: caller lacks upload capability on matter (grant.capabilities missing 'uploadDocument')

errors.name: CidExists
errors.description: cid already uploaded for this matter (use updateDocument to supersede)
